scope: System repair and token-efficiency changes after the full-delivery paid run; no new paid model calls
confirmedProblems: Audio-owned soundRequired flags produce impossible required-source mapping diagnostics, directing revision to the wrong field.
A schema type error in an inapplicable Art sound table hides its table ownership error until another revision/check cycle.
Review treats different document-local professional IDs as necessarily conflicting; its close conditions fail to target structural causes.
--design-handoff-help returns useful instructions but no ok/valid flag, so the real bundled CLI exits 1 on success.

Technical author repeats official-document fetch/extraction work; its WebFetch calls fail because Tavily configuration is missing, and its fallback repeatedly searches an artificially truncated prefix.
A finite review-step count does not prevent many internal speculative edits/checks: Joint Revise performed 32 model calls, 31 Edit calls and six handoff checks.

implemented.change: Check existing field applicability before item-type parsing; report the exact field and preserve legitimate professional prose/values/ownership. Validate soundRequired only on GDD/UI producers and reject its misuse elsewhere with one scoped diagnostic rather than seven impossible Audio-source mapping errors.
implemented.boundary: Invalid handoffs still fail. Actual missing GDD/UI mapping, unknown sources, type errors, source hashes and due dependencies are not relaxed. No new tables, taxonomy, protocol or automatic repair.

implemented.change: Successful --design-handoff-help returns ok:true and a scope; real bundled CLI exits 0.

Review acceptance distinguishes document-local names from conflicting decisions; structural findings must close the actual field error without inventing source IDs or transferring professional ownership.
implemented.boundary: Existing Inspect/Revise/Verify sequence and host stop rules are unchanged.

implemented.change: Revise the existing tool-work guidance: understand the diagnosed field before edits, group related changes and invalidated checks, retain complete results, and stop speculative ID/prose experiments. Judge producer/consumer behavior rather than name similarity.
implemented.boundary: Method only; no additional edit/retry/release authority and no second ownership definition.

implemented.change: Batch justified platform evidence retrieval, retain actual bytes once, extract relevant complete passages without iterative searches of truncated prefixes, and distinguish missing tool configuration from URL/content failure.
implemented.boundary: Evidence obligations remain; unsupported consequential claims cannot become confirmed facts to save tokens. No new network helper, account configuration change or blanket evidence-fetch requirement.

regressions: Field ownership remains visible alongside invalid types, rather than being hidden by them.
Audio misuse fails at the flag; an actually valid GDD-to-Audio mapping passes after using the appropriate flag scope in a synthetic fixture.
Unknown GDD source and unmapped real producer still fail; no weakening of coverage.
Owned visual values in prose and differently named visual/audio outputs remain valid without a shared global namespace.
Actual bundled handoff-help command exits 0 without design/resource prerequisites.

issues: AUDIO_DESIGN.md: outputs[].soundRequired is only for GDD/UI sound producers; remove this flag from owned outputs (EV-start, EV-catch-fruit, EV-hit-junk, EV-miss-fruit, EV-clear, EV-over, EV-restart). Audio describes required sounds in events and binds events.source to the actual GDD/UI producer; changing source IDs cannot fix this flag
readOnlyPaidArtifactCheck.note: No generated file was edited. Earlier observer doc-only snapshots lack the retained .beegame content contract, so their missing-contract diagnostics are observer snapshot incompleteness, not product findings; final check uses the intact original workspace.

tokenEffect.expectedMechanism: Direct correct-field diagnostics remove the proven wrong repair path; grouped evidence retrieval and related edits/checks reduce model round trips carrying accumulated history.
tokenEffect.warning: Local tests establish deterministic correctness, not model compliance, semantic review quality or a token-saving percentage. A new authorized paid run is required to measure these.

tradeoffs: Clearer grouped field diagnostics change diagnostic text but not the handoff format or valid source data.
Batching related work can reduce intermediate feedback; necessary source inspection and dependent operations remain sequential where needed.
Skill guidance still depends on the model executing it. No guaranteed cost cap or semantic correctness claim is made.
The original stopped paid project remains stopped and unmodified. No case-specific substitute draft or forced receipt was used.
